由督察员潘连璧（Pan Lien-pih）撰写，由C. Gaspar d.J.转呈

3月28日下午1时至2时之间，约400名工人阶级群众聚集在中山路的大夏大学。一名戴深色眼镜的中国男子王（Wong）担任主席。据信他是日文报纸《顺天报》（Shun Sun Pao）的编辑，该报以中文出版。他宣布当天3月28日是预定成立新“华中政府”的日子，并建议在场所有人参加定于今日举行的庆祝活动，还鼓动听众高呼“新政府万岁”的口号，这一要求随即得到执行，在场群众高呼该口号三次。随后燃放了大量鞭炮，持续约一小时。现场聘请了一支铜管乐队提供音乐，在会议开始前和结束时演奏了选曲。

会议结束后，每位在场者均获发一条面包和八十美分。人群安静散去，未提及组织游行或示威活动。

约有二十名日本士兵和一队大道市政府警察在场。

March 25, 1938. Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Wan Pao (March 24) :-

NEW GOVERNMENT AT NANKING TO BE INAUGURATED APRIL 1

According to information from reliable sources,
an understanding has been reached between the "Reformed
Government" of the Chinese Republic" and the Provisional
Government at Peiping by the representatives of the "Reformed
Government with the leading figures in North China.
It is learned that on March 23, officials of
the new regime held a meeting at Nanking to discuss the
date of inauguration. The result is not available, but
it is probable that the inauguration will take place on
April 1. It is reported that decorations are being made
on the various streets in Nanking to celebrate the
inauguration. The new government will use the five-
coloured flag in compliance with the views of the North
China authorities.

Tsang Sz-chao's Denial

On March 24, Mr. Tsang Sz-chao (章士釗), who
was once an official of the Peiping Government, flatly
denied the report that he had been offered the post of
President of the Legislative Yuan of the "Central China
Government" at Nanking.
Mr. Tsang, who has been living at Tientsin
for the past six months, declares that he has no intention
to take part in any political activities.

Subject Inauguration of Central China Government - again delayed.
Made by and Forwarded by.. Inspector Papp.

Chiefly, owing to objections raised by the Peking
Government, the inaugural ceremonies which were to have taken
place last Sunday, March 20, were unavoidably again postponed
for a few days.
The Peking Government is claiming the right to take
control over all areas occupied by the Japanese Forces and,
therefore, object to the establishment of another government in
Central China.
The Japanese Military and Naval Authorities do not
support this claim. Apart from merely Japanese considerations,
the Japanese Authorities are guided by the realization that
conditions in general are entirely different in North and
Central China and further, that the mentality and the tempera-
mental disposition of the people in Central China are totally
different from Northern Chinese, in due consideration of which,
they are determined to establish an entirely independent
Central Government at Nanking.

Hwa Mei Wan Pao Morning Edition :-

INAUGURATION OF NEW REGIME AT NANKING AGAIN POSTPONED

Although all the high officials of the
new administration are now at Nanking, the formal
inauguration of the new government did not take place
yesterday. This is due to the fact that arrangements
had not yet been fully completed, but principally
because of the question of its amalgamation with the
Peiping Provisional Government. General Iwane Matsui,
the former Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese forces,
was of the opinion that a separate government should be
established in Central China, but Japan's universal
policy towards requires that a "Central Government"
should be established in China. General Iwane Matsui
objected to the political influence of the North China
regime being extended to Central China and advocated
the amalgamation of the North China regime with the
"Central China Government".
Recently, the North China regime delegated
General Hsu Hsi-yuan (齐燮元) as its representative
to the South to resume negotiations over the question
of amalgamation with the Japanese military authorities
and those persons connected with the new "Central China
Government". According to information from Japanese
sources, General Hsu's representative arrived at Nanking
on March 9, while General Hsu arrived there on March 12.
General Hata, the new Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese
Expeditionary Forces, proceeded to Nanking on March 13.
In view of all this, it can be definitely assumed that
negotiations over the question of the amalgamation of
the two governments will be resumed.

Ta Mei Wan Pao (March 16) :-

Title of Government to be "Reformed Government of the
Chinese Republic"

There is a report that the inauguration of
the new organization at Nanking has been postponed for
one week. Persons taking part in the new organization
are already in Nanking, while General Hata, Commander-in-
Chief of the Japanese Forces in Central China, proceeded
to Nanking on March 14 to direct the inauguration.
Information secured by this paper shows that
the name of the new organization has now been definitely
changed to "Reformed Government of the Chinese Republic".
Liang Hung-tse (梁鴻志), Wen Chung-yao (溫宗堯), Tsang
Sz-chao (章士釗), Chen Chun (陳羣), Wong Ts-wei (王子偉),
Chen Chung-fu (陳中孚), Chen Loh (陳籙) and Chen Cheh-min
(陳則民) will hold high posts in the new Nanking organization.
Liang Hung-tse, Wen Chung-yao and Tsang Sz-chao will be
the Presidents of the Yuans. It is now certain that
Chen Chun will be Minister of Interior and concurrently
Mayor of Shanghai; Chen Cheh-min will be Minister of
Education; Chen Loh will be Minister of Foreign Affairs.

《华美晚报》晨刊 :-

南京新政权成立典礼再次推迟

尽管新行政机构的所有高官现已抵达南京，但新政府的正式成立典礼昨日并未举行。这是因为安排尚未完全完成，但主要是因为其与北平临时政府合并的问题。前日军总司令松井石根将军（General Iwane Matsui）认为应在华中建立一个独立的政府，但日本对华普遍政策要求在中国建立一个“中央政府”。松井石根将军反对华北政权的政治影响力扩展至华中，并主张将华北政权与“华中政府”合并。
最近，华北政权委派齐燮元将军（General Hsu Hsi-yuan）作为其代表前往南方，就与日本军事当局及与新“华中政府”有关人士的合并问题恢复谈判。据日本方面消息，齐将军的代表于3月9日抵达南京，而齐将军本人于3月12日抵达。新任日本远征军总司令畑俊六将军（General Hata）于3月13日前往南京。鉴于此，可以肯定地假设，关于两个政府合并问题的谈判将恢复。

《大美晚报》（3月16日）:-

政府名称定为“中华民国维新政府”

有报道称，南京新组织的成立典礼已推迟一周。参与新组织的人员已抵达南京，而华中日军总司令畑俊六将军于3月14日前往南京指导成立典礼。
本报获得的消息显示，新组织的名称现已正式改为“中华民国维新政府”。梁鸿志（Liang Hung-tse）、温宗尧（Wen Chung-yao）、章士钊（Tsang Sz-chao）、陈群（Chen Chun）、王子伟（Wong Ts-wei）、陈中孚（Chen Chung-fu）、陈箓（Chen Loh）和陈则民（Chen Cheh-min）将在南京新组织中担任高职。梁鸿志、温宗尧和章士钊将担任各院院长。现在可以确定，陈群将任内政部长兼上海市市长；陈则民将任教育部长；陈箓将任外交部长。参与新组织的中国人

first work for the restoration of peace and order in the

in consequence of an order from Tokyo, and that the
celebrations arranged for March 16 was therefore cancelled.

opinion that the present national flag of China and the
name of Kuomintang be retained. A number of Chinese,
who are connected with the new government, proceeded to
Nanking on March 15 for the purpose of making arrangements
for the proposed inauguration.

主题 南市局势及华中政府成立情况。

由 警探 范连璧（Fan Lien-pih）制作 经由 C. Crawford S.I. 转呈

3月15日上午，南市自治委员会打算以每面0.80元的价格，向居住在南市和难民区的民众出售5,000面“五色旗”（中国前国旗），以便在3月16日上午悬挂这些旗帜，纪念华中政府在南京成立。民众以价格过高为借口，拒绝购买旗帜。

同日下午3时，自治委员会发布消息，称由于东京方面下达命令，新政府的成立已被推迟，因此原定于3月16日举行的庆祝活动取消。旗帜目前保存在委员会办公室，留待日后使用。

据信，华中政府成立的推迟是由于对所采用旗帜问题的争议所致：军方认为应使用“五色旗”并弃用“国民党”名称，而政治和外交界则主张保留中国现行国旗和国民党名称。一些与新政府有关联的中国人于3月15日前往南京，旨在为拟议的成立仪式做出安排。

《中国日报》：

        司法院院长

        目前在天津的章士钊（Tsang Sz-chao (章士釗)）已被内定为司法院院长。据报道，他将于4月初来沪。

        上海海关监督

their seats, a manifesto was issued, stating that the
"Reformed Government" is a temporary administration and is
not a rival of the Provisional Government at Peiping. As
soon as communications have been restored, the "Reformed
Government" will be amalgamated with the Provisional
Government.

Standard

Police Adopt Precautionary Measures

Having received information that certain
persons might attempt to hold a procession in the Foreign
Settlements of Shanghai in celebration of the formation
of the new government, the police authorities of the two
Settlements adopted precautionary measures at 8 a.m.
yesterday. Extra policemen were posted at important
points, patrols were sent out to search suspicious-looking
persons and armoured cars and police vans were mobilized.
The day passed off quietly.

Coolies and Beggars Paid to March in Processions

The five-barred flag was hoisted over the
Sun Ya Hotel, North Szechuen Road, and the "Revenue Bureau"
at the corner of Kiukiang and Kiangse Roads. Persons
connected with the new organization went to Zau Ka Tu in
the morning and assembled more than 4,000 coolies and
beggars from the jetties and alleyways. Each was given a
strip of yellow cloth bearing the character "Huang" (黄)
and the words "Commemoration of the Inauguration of the
Reformed Government of the Chinese Republic", and were told
to march in procession in the area under Japanese military
occupation. During the procession fire crackers were
set off. In the afternoon a dollar was issued to each
of the coolies and beggars upon production of the strip of
yellow cloth.

Residents and small shops in Nantao and
Pootung were forced to fly the five-barred flag while
the Japanese flag and the "Tai Chi" flag were also displayed
at road intersections. At 8 a.m. a party of Japanese
soldiers marched in demonstration along Boulevard des Deux
Republiques. At 3 p.m. about fifty boats, flying the
five-barred flag and towed by a motor boat, proceeded up
and down the Whangpoo with the people on the boats letting
off large and small crackers.

Aeroplane Falls in Whangpoo

A number of aeroplanes were detailed by the
local Japanese military authorities to distribute pamphlets
and copies of the "Nanking People's News" (南京民报) over
Shanghai and along the Shanghai-Nanking and Shanghai-Hangchow
Railways. One of these planes fell into the Whangpoo at
Nantao at about 3 p.m., drawing a hail of derisive cheers
from the Chinese ashore. Japanese gendarmes in the vicinity
immediately charged the Chinese with their rifles, injuring
many persons. Father Jacquinot of the Refugee Zone opened
negotiations and prevented the incident from becoming more
serious.

发表了一份宣言，声明“维新政府”是一个临时行政机构，并非北平临时政府的对手。一旦交通恢复，“维新政府”将与临时政府合并。

《字林西报》

警方采取预防措施

鉴于获悉某些人可能试图在上海外国租界举行游行以庆祝新政府的成立，两个租界的警察当局于昨日上午8时采取了预防措施。在重要地点增派了警察，派出巡逻队搜查形迹可疑的人员，并动员了装甲车和警车。当天平静度过。

苦力和乞丐受雇参加游行

五色旗在四川北路孙雅饭店（Sun Ya Hotel）以及九江路与江西路拐角处的“税务局”升起。与新组织有关的人员上午前往曹家渡（Zau Ka Tu），从码头和弄堂里聚集了4,000多名苦力和乞丐。每人发给一条印有“黄”字和“纪念中华民国维新政府成立”字样的黄布条，并被告知在日本军事占领区范围内列队游行。游行期间燃放了鞭炮。下午，苦力和乞丐凭黄布条每人领取一美元。

南市和浦东的居民和小商店被迫悬挂五色旗，同时在道路交叉口也展示了日本国旗和“太极”旗（指伪满洲国国旗）。上午8时，一队日本士兵沿两共和国路（Boulevard des Deux Republiques，今复兴东路）游行示威。下午3时左右，约五十艘悬挂五色旗的船只由一艘摩托艇拖曳，在黄浦江上来回行驶，船上的人燃放了大小鞭炮。

飞机坠入黄浦江

当地日本军方部署多架飞机在上海及沪宁、沪杭铁路沿线散发传单和《南京民报》。其中一架飞机于下午3时左右在南市坠入黄浦江，引来岸上中国人的阵阵嘲讽欢呼。附近的日本宪兵立即持步枪冲向中国人，造成多人受伤。难民区的饶家驹神父（Father Jacquinot）展开交涉，防止事态进一步恶化。

March 29, 1938.                                  Morning Translation

China Daily News :-

        Celebrations in Great China University

        In celebration of the inauguration of the
"Central China Government," a section of the residents of
Shanghai yesterday afternoon held a meeting in the Great
China University (大夏大学) in the Western District of
Shanghai.    About 10,000 persons were present representing
the "Shanghai Spinning and Weaving General Labour Union,"
the "Shanghai Wharf General Labour Union," the "Oriental
Huang Dao Society" (東方黃道協會), the various branches of the
"Hsin Ya Hsuei" ("Asiatic Revival Society"), the "Shanghai
Seamen's General Union," etc.    The meeting came to order
at 1.40 p.m. at which hour fire crackers were let off for
15 minutes.    At 1.55 p.m. Zeng Nyoh-tsing (常玉清), chair-
man, and Feng Soh-lien (叔鸞 ) and other members of the
presidium walked to the stand closely guarded by Japanese
soldiers and Chinese pickets.
        Zeng Nyoh-tsing delivered a speech on the
significance of the establishment of the new government,
in the course of which he said that the people after suffering
every form of oppression will be relieved of their sufferings
by the new government.
        Feng Soh-lien also delivered an address.
        Finally under the leadership of Zang Ko-chiang
(尚慕姜), the following slogans were shouted :-
        "Overthrow the Communist Party"
        "Support peace in the Orient"
        "Long live the Republic of China"
        "Long live the Imperial Japanese Army"
        The proceedings came to a close at 2.10 p.m.

        At 1 p.m. a procession was staged in Zau Ka
Tu (曹家渡) district.    At 10 p.m. a celebration was held
at the New Asia Hotel on North Szechuen Road.

Ta Mei Wan Pao Morning Editions:-

        Japanese Soldiers Hold Procession in Nantao

        A party of Japanese soldiers held a procession
on Boulevard des Deux Republiques at 8 a.m., with persons
connected with the "autonomous committee" at Nanking
following behind them.    Slogans such as "Down With the
Kuomintang" and "Down With the Communist Party" were shouted.
        At 11 a.m. a Japanese military plane distributed
pamphlets over Shanghai and along the Shanghai-Nanking and
Shanghai-Hangchow Railways.    The pamphlets read:- "Chinese
People! You are not the enemies of the Japanese army.
You should have confidence in the Japanese army."

        French Police Arrest Two Pedestrians

        During a search of pedestrians in the vicinity
of the Great World, Avenue Edward VII, at 11 a.m. yesterday,
a party of French detectives and policemen arrested two
pedestrians.    On their person were found badges of the Dah
Dao City Government, pamphlets containing slogans relating to
the inauguration of the "Central China Government" and a
large number of handbills.
        The two men were taken to the Police Station
and were released after an interrogation.

1938年3月29日。                                  晨间译件

《中国日报》：

        大夏大学举行庆祝活动

        为庆祝“华中政府”成立，上海部分居民于昨日下午在上海西区的大夏大学（Great China University）举行集会。约有10,000人出席，代表包括“上海纺织业总工会”、“上海码头总工会”、“东方黄道协会”、“新亚学会”（Asiatic Revival Society）各分会、“上海海员工会”等。会议于下午1时40分正式开始，届时燃放鞭炮15分钟。下午1时55分，主席常玉清（Zeng Nyoh-tsing）以及叔鸞（Feng Soh-lien，音译）等主席团成员在日本士兵和中国纠察队的严密护卫下走向讲台。
        常玉清发表演讲，阐述建立新政府的意义，他在演讲中表示，饱受各种压迫的人民将在新政府的治理下解除痛苦。
        叔鸞也发表了讲话。
        最后，在尚慕姜（Zang Ko-chiang，音译）的带领下，众人高呼以下口号：
        “打倒共产党”
        “拥护东亚和平”
        “中华民国万岁”
        “大日本帝国军队万岁”
        活动于下午2时10分结束。

        下午1时，曹家渡（Zau Ka Tu）地区举行了游行。晚上10时，北四川路的新亚酒店举行了庆祝活动。

《大美晚报》晨刊：

        日军在南市举行游行

        上午8时，一队日本士兵在共和路（Boulevard des Deux Republiques）举行游行，南京“自治委员会”的相关人员跟随其后。人群中高呼“打倒国民党”和“打倒共产党”等口号。
        上午11时，一架日本军用飞机在上海及沪宁、沪杭铁路沿线散发传单。传单内容如下：“中国人民！你们不是日军的敌人。你们应该对日军抱有信心。”

        法租界警察逮捕两名行人

        昨日上午11时，法租界侦探和警察在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）大世界附近搜查行人时，逮捕了两名行人。在他们身上发现了大道市政府的徽章、包含有关“华中政府”成立口号的传单以及大量小册子。
        这两人被带到警察局，经讯问后获释。

Proclamation of the Reformed
Government of the Republic of China.

During recent years all sorts of government
affairs have been in a state of disorder and the
Government is full of Jackards, who are unaware
of diplomacy but all boasters.

They never train people but only make them go
to war and they made no military preparation but only
depend upon empty talk, not only sacrificing peoples
lives and making the nation the last and only stake
but also rendering the good territory and Capital in
a ruined state, throwing all the people out of employment.

The policy of ruining the territory is suicidal,
and toleration of Communists is similar to the calling in
of bandits, which is the worst policy in the history of
a Chinese Government, even the notorious kings Jieh and
Chou would not tolerate such a policy.

Although they are at present taking improper ease
in Szechuen and hiding in Hunan, they have already lost
their military control.

In view of this and to avoid the perishing of our
nation, therefore on the 28th day of March, we re-establish
the Reformed Government of the Republic of China in Nanking
with a policy of recovering the territory and sovereignty
similar to that prior to the war, and to co-operate with
neighbouring nations, and to avoid conflict between the
same race, and in order to establishing a real peace in
the Orient and maintaining the co-operation among the
American and European nations, that is our historical morality.

The establishment of the Reformed Government is
only based on the facts prevalent in Chekiang, Kiangsu and
other Provinces and is of a temporary nature and will be

中华民国维新政府宣言。

近年来，各类政务处于混乱状态，政府中充斥著庸碌之辈，他们不懂外交，只会夸夸其谈。

他们从不训练民众，只驱使民众参战；不做军事准备，只依赖空谈，不仅牺牲人民生命，将国家置于孤注一掷的境地，还使大好国土和首都沦为废墟，导致所有人民失业。

这种毁土政策无异于自杀，而容忍共产党则如同引狼入室，这是中国政府历史上最糟糕的政策，即使是臭名昭著的桀、纣王也不会容忍这样的政策。

虽然他们目前躲在四川苟且偷安，藏身于湖南，但他们已经失去了军事控制权。

鉴于此，为避免我国灭亡，因此于3月28日，我们在南京重新建立中华民国维新政府，采取恢复战前领土和主权的政策，并与邻国合作，避免同种相残，旨在建立真正的东亚和平，并维持欧美各国间的合作，这是我们的历史道德。

维新政府的建立仅基于浙江、江苏及其他省份的普遍事实，具有临时性质，并将

joined together with the Provisional Government when the

returned to normality owing to the fact that we do not wish
our nation to have two different governments.
The most urgent and important measures we should
adopt at present moment is to restore the order of agricultural
villages and assist the commerce to prosperity, and to
maintain peace and pacify the distressed people.
We will do our utmost to maintain peace, avoid
the havoc of war, and preserve the national strength.
We dare not cheat our distressed people with
empty talk.

中華民國維新政府成立宣言

近年百政腐敗，群小盈廷，不諳外交，但矜豪語，不教民而使作戰，
無軍備而恃空言，不啻以民命為犧牲，以國家為孤注，遂致神州喪，
京邑邱墟，萬竈無煙，四民失業，當國者喪師愈衆，報捷愈頻，失地
愈多，搜括愈甚，未聞舉一事以省愆，出一言以罪己，焦土政策，等
於自戕，容納共產，同召寇，是中國有史以來惟一之惡政府，其居心
行事，蓋桀紂所不肯為，獻所不忍出者也，現雖苟安已蜀，潛伏荊
湘，但以竊號自娛，已失統御之力，同人等激於義憤，急起救亡，除舊
布新，與民更始，爰於三月二十八日在南京重建中華民國維新政府，
其惟一使命，則在使領土主權，復現戰前狀態，與隣邦將狙折衝，歸
於敦睦，務使國人免鋒鏑之苦，同離無莫豆之爭，本吾國舊有道德，
確立東亞之和平，更與歐美列邦，保持聯絡，至維新政府之成立，係
根據蘇浙等省之事實，原為暫時性質，與臨時政府初無對立之心，向來
中央所管事項之不可分析者，仍由臨時政府商酌辦理，一俟津浦海
兩路恢復交通，即與臨時政府合併，蓋同人等雅不願國內有對峙之兩
政府也，至於恢復秩序，撫輯流亡，安定農村，復興商業，皆目前最急
之務，謹當集合群力，逐一進行，俾我父老子弟諸姑伯姊，各安常業，
漸復生機，為人民減少一分兵災，即為國家多留一分元氣，譬之醫病，
急則治標，必待標病既除，徐圖培補，不敢空談治理，高語富強，以
欺我困苦顛連九死一生之民衆也，明知荊榛遍地，烽燧彌天，復舊國
於灰燼之餘，撫黎民於孑遺之後，程功不易，着手尤難，惟有各盡知
能，完我使命，天視民視，矢志不渝，用特宣言，敢告有衆。

An old saying of our sagacious forefathers runs that
spring is the best time to start one's career. In this season, the
universe puts on a new dress; all men enjoy their life and all
nations plan for their prosperity.
Under these lovely circumstances, comes into existence the
Reformed Government of the Republic of China. Its inauguration
takes place in Nanking, the former capital of our past emperors,
which was for over ten years captured by bandits who have now been
wiped out, in deference to the wishes of our people. Flourishing
conditions have now returned to this old city.
The Government is founded under principles as follows:-
To abolish the exclusive administration by one single party.
To bring about the "Three Rights' Constitutional State".
To prevent Communism in order that the East Asia may not be
bolshevized.
To obtain equal terms in diplomacy, to preserve sovereignty.
To ameliorate relations with friendly nations.
To meet the demand of the present world's tendency.
To effect permanent rapprochement with all covenant nations.
To give relief to unemployed.
To open resources.
To promote industry.
To improve agriculture.
To make enormous purchase of foreign goods with a view to
obtaining economic cooperation.
The above are all vital projects required in the inauguration
of a nation.
A government will not satisfy its people unless administrated
by men possessing uncommon intellectual power. In the Reformed
Government of the Republic of China, we have the following men as
heads who are all endowed with genius: Liang Hoong Tse, Wen Tsoong
Yao, Tsang Sz Ching etc. We have as members of the Cabinet the
following men who are well-known heroes and patriots:- Zung Tse Ming,

我们要圣明的祖先有一句古话：春天是开创事业的最佳时机。在这个季节，宇宙焕然一新；人人享受生活，各国谋划繁荣。
在这美好的形势下，中华民国维新政府应运而生。其成立仪式在我们过去皇帝的旧都南京举行，该地曾被匪徒占据十余年，如今匪徒已被肃清，此举顺应了我国人民的愿望。这座古城现已重现繁荣景象。
本政府建立在以下原则之上：
废除一党专政。
实现“三权宪法国家”。
防止共产主义，以使东亚不被布尔什维克化。
争取外交平等，维护主权。
改善与友好国家的关系。
顺应当今世界潮流。
与所有缔约国实现永久和解。
救济失业者。
开发资源。
促进工业。
改善农业。
大量购买外国商品，以获得经济合作。
以上均为建国所需的重要项目。
除非由具备非凡智力的人才进行管理，否则政府无法满足其人民的需求。在中华民国维新政府中，我们有以下天才人物担任首领：梁鸿志（Liang Hoong Tse）、温宗尧（Wen Tsoong Yao）、曾世庆（Tsang Sz Ching，音译）等。我们有以下知名英雄和爱国者担任内阁成员：宗泽明（Zung Tse Ming，音译），

Extra issue of the Shanghai Nippo - dated March 28, 1938.
NEW REGIME FORMED AT DESIRE OF PEOPLE OF CENTRAL CHINA
The important members of the new
Chinese Government formed to-day at Nanking are as follows :-
Acting President of Executive Yuan:- Liang Hung-tse.
President of Legislative Yuan:- Wen Chung-yao.
President of Judicial Yuan:- Not appointed.
Minister of Interior:- Chen Chun.
Acting Minister of Pacification:- Zung Yuan-teo.
Minister of Foreign Affairs:- Chen Loh.
Minister of Communications:- Liang Hung-tse.
Minister of Finance:- Chen Ching-tse.
Minister of Industry:- Wong Ts-huei.
Minister of Education:- Chen Cheh-ming.
At 11 a.m. March 28 the inauguration
of the new "Central Government" took place at Nanking at the
desire of 300,000,000 people. This is a new era for the people
who have suffered for a long time under Chiang Kai-shek's regime.
As a result of Chiang Kai-shek's overthrow by the Japanese army
the Chinese people have been released from their heavy yoke and
are willing to co-operate with the new regime. The
300,000,000 people of Central China now understand the real
cause of the Sino-Japanese hostilities. A new regime has come
into existence in accordance with the desire of the people
after the corrupt administration of the Kuomintang has been
removed by the Japanese army. A number of prominent Chinese
began to move at the beginning of January this year to form a
new regime and Mr. Liang Hung-tse, Mr. Chen Chun and Mr. Wong
Ts-huei started to prepare for the formation of the new regime
in the middle of February. The preparatory activities were
suspended for a time because on March 7 General Chow Feng-chi,
who was to have been appointed to a high position in the new
government, was assassinated. The new central regime
will co-operate fully with the new government formed in the north.

今日在南京成立的新中国政府的重要成员如下：
行政院代院长：梁鸿志。
立法院院长：温宗尧。

教育部长：陈则民。
3月28日上午11时，新的“中央政府”在南京顺应三亿民众的愿望举行了就职典礼。这对于长期遭受蒋介石政权统治苦难的人民来说是一个新时代。由于日本军队推翻了蒋介石，中国人民从重压下解放出来，并愿意与新政权合作。华中三亿民众现在明白了中日敌对行动的真正原因。在日本军队清除了国民党的腐败行政之后，一个新政权顺应民众意愿应运而生。今年1月初，一些中国知名人士开始活动以组建新政权，梁鸿志先生、陈群先生和王季惠先生于2月中旬开始准备组建新政权。筹备活动曾暂时中断，因为原拟在新政府中担任高职的周凤岐将军于3月7日遇刺身亡。新的中央政权将与北方成立的新政府充分合作。

1938年3月28日上午10时45分左右，刑事侦缉员176号打电话给捕房，称约有2000名苦力成群结队地沿着兆丰路（Jessfield Road）向铁路道口行进。

ADVICE TO OUR COMRADES

Oppose the Chiang Kai-shek regime and support
the new "central government."

We have suffered under the cruel measures employed
by Chiang Kai-shek. Even under present conditions, he is
still trying to defraud the people of their money. The
herd under Chiang (such as Soong and Kung) care only about
their own pockets; they do their utmost to extract money from
the people and deposit it in foreign banks. They care
nothing for the welfare of the people. If the resistance
continues like this, hundreds of thousands of refugees will
die of starvation. You, comrades, who have tasted the
cruelties of Chiang's government, should come to your senses.

Should the Communists come into power, we will
perhaps suffer a worse fate. This is realized by all who
have had previous experience with the Communist Party.

We should immediately rise and overthrow Chiang and
his herd. Under the leadership of a new government, we
shall enjoy a contented life as in the case of the people in
North China. Let us find a way to security and happiness
under the new regime.

Oriental Peace Society.

告同胞书

反对蒋介石政权，支持新的“中央政府”。

Spring is a joyous season. This spring is
all the more joyful because of an event which brings
happiness not to one individual or family only, but to
the whole nation. This event is the inauguration of
the "Reformed Government of the Chinese Republic" which
has taken place at Nanking in accordance with the will
of Heaven and the people, and the earnest desire of the
whole world.

For the past ten years, Nanking has been
under the control of the corrupt Kuomintang and the
Communist Party. Their atrocious policies incurred
the deep hatred of the people. Now that these
lawless elements have gone, their noxious influences
have disappeared.

The policy of the new government will be as
follows :-

(1) To enforce a constitutional system of
government and to abolish party rule.

(2) To suppress Communism so that it may
not menace the East Asia.

(3) To make friends with neighbouring states
on the basis of equality and integrity of sovereign
rights, and to maintain lasting peace with all foreign
countries.

(4) To relieve the unemployed, to exploit
the natural resources of the country and to develop
industries and commerce; to welcome foreign investments
and to carry out economic co-operation with friendly
nations.

This may be said to be an ambitious way of
administering a country, but the success of any system

“中华民国维新政府”的诞生

春天是一个欢乐的季节。今年的春天格外令人喜悦，因为有一件事不仅给个人或家庭带来幸福，而且给整个国家带来幸福。这件事就是顺应天意民心以及全世界殷切愿望而在南京成立的“中华民国维新政府”。

过去十年，南京一直控制在腐败的国民党和共产党手中。他们的暴政招致了人民的深仇大恨。现在这些无法无天之徒已经离去，他们的恶劣影响也已消失。

新政府的政策如下：

(1) 实行宪政体制，废除党治。

(2) 镇压共产主义，使其不再威胁东亚。

(3) 在平等和尊重主权完整的基础上与邻国友好相处，并与所有外国保持持久和平。

(4) 救济失业者，开发国家自然资源，发展工商业；欢迎外资，并与友好国家开展经济合作。

这可以说是一种雄心勃勃的治国之道，但任何制度的成功

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

CP

In celebrating the inauguration in Nanking of the so-
called "Reformed Government of the Republic of China," the
old five-barred national flag was displayed and meetings
and processions were held in Japanese occupied areas around
Shanghai on March 28. These functions were sponsored by
Chinese agents believed to be in the employ of the Japanese
and attended by persons of the coolie and loafer type who
were recruited on monetary considerations.

A brief account of the events which occurred during the
day at various places is given hereunder:-

Between 1 p.m. and 2 p.m., a meeting was held by some
400 persons of the worker and coolie classes in the Great
China University building on Chungsan Road, O.O.L. One named
Jong (王), who is believed to be the editor of the Sin
Shun Pao, Chinese edition of the Japanese daily "Shanghai
Goddo," acted as chairman, and about twenty Japanese soldiers
and a party of Dah Dao City Government Police were in attendance.
The programme consisted of merely the shouting of the slogan
"Long live the New Government" and the firing of a large
quantity of crackers which proceedings lasted for about one
hour. Music was also provided by a brass band hired for the
occasion. Upon the termination of the meeting each person
present was issued with a loaf of bread and eighty cents after
which the crowd dispersed quietly.

About 7 p.m., approximately sixty persons of the coolie class congregated at the entrance to the roochow Road market on Chekiang Road. Each of them held one half of a white blank visiting card bearing a chop. A foreman then appeared and issued to each the sum of eighty cents. According to one of the men, they were hired and had attended a meeting on Chungsan Road. The crowd dispersed at 8 p.m.

Between 10 a.m. and 11.30 a.m., the Nantao Autonomous Commission held a meeting of some 400 refugees and primary school students (in Pootung and Nantao) in the Wen Miao Temple, Wen Miao Road, Nantao. Thirty members of the Special Section of the Japanese troops stationed in Nantao also attended. Chen Yuin (陳雲), Chairman of the Autonomous Commission, presided and addressed the attendance on the prospects of the new government in Nanking. A ceremony in honour of Confucius was also held when those present bowed three times to the image of the Saint. At the conclusion of the meeting, which was marked with the shouting of the slogans, "Long live the Reformed Government" and "Long live the Peace in the Far East" and the firing of crackers, a number of those present were entertained to a tiffin party on the same premises while the remaining persons formed a procession and paraded streets surrounding the Wen Miao Temple until 12.30 p.m. when they dispersed. These processionists carried both the five barred flags and Japanese flags.

Summarized translation of a handbill bearing on the
inauguration of a new government in Nanking, copies
of which were dropped from Japanese airplanes flying
over the Settlement and French Concession on 28/3/38.
............

Manifesto on the inauguration of the Reformed
Government of the Republic of China

Political administrations in the past were
corrupt. Government positions were filled by
incompetent persons who were ignorant of the ethics
of diplomacy, but were very fond of boasting of
their power. The soldiers were compelled to fight
without being properly trained and military
preparations were at a discount, and through this
state of affairs the capital and other cities were
reduced to ashes and many people became homeless and
unemployed. News of victories were spread throughout
the land, which were in reality defeats, and the
practice of corruption was continued. The former
government of China was the worst government that
has ever been set up as it joined hands with the
communists, who are no better than bandits. The
present government in Szechuen is unable to control
the territories under which it claims jurisdiction.

Because of our indignation at such a state of
affairs and for the purpose of saving the nation, we
established on March 28, the Reformed Government of
the Republic of China in Nanking. We will endeavour
to restore pre-war conditions in areas within our
jurisdiction and create friendly relations with the
neighbouring countries. This will save the people
from further war and disaster and will also prevent
civil war. In accordance with the aims of old Chinese
custom we will firmly establish oriental peace and
maintain relationship with the European and American
countries.

1938年3月28日，日本飞机飞越公共租界和法租界上空时散发的传单译文摘要，该传单涉及南京新政府的成立。
............

中华民国维新政府成立宣言

过去的政治行政腐败不堪。政府职位由不称职者占据，这些人不懂外交伦理，却极爱夸耀权势。士兵未经适当训练即被迫参战，军事准备废弛，因此导致首都及其他城市化为灰烬，许多人无家可归且失业。虚假的胜利消息传遍全国，实则为败绩，腐败行径仍在继续。前中国政府是有史以来最糟糕的政府，因为它与无异于匪徒的共产党勾结。目前位于四川的政府无法控制其声称拥有管辖权的领土。

出于对这种局势的愤慨，并为拯救国家起见，我们于3月28日在南京成立了中华民国维新政府。我们将努力恢复辖区内的战前状况，并与邻国建立友好关系。这将使人民免受进一步的战争和灾难，并防止内战。我们将依照中国古老传统的宗旨， firmly 确立东方和平，并保持与欧美国家的关系。

pages.en:
- 2 -

The Reformed Government was established to
rehabilitate the provinces including Kiangsu and
Chekiang. It was of a temporary nature and had
no intention of opposing the Provisional Government
(in Peiping). What was controlled by the Central
Government could not be divided, and therefore is
managed by the provisional government. As soon as
the communications along the Tientsin-Pukow and the
Lunghai railways have been restored, the Reformed
Government will be amalgamated with the provisional
government, as we do not wish to have two governments
in one country.

Our present important task is to restore order
and pacify refugees and promote commerce and farming.
We will undertake one task at a time with all our
concentrated energy so as to enable the succeeding
generation to live and trade in peace. We swear to
do our best in rebuilding the country out of the
present chaos.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

维新政府的成立旨在重建包括江苏和浙江在内的各省。该政府具有临时性质，无意反对（在北平的）临时政府。中央政府所控制的区域不可分割，因此由临时政府管理。一旦津浦铁路和陇海铁路的交通恢复，维新政府将与临时政府合并，因为我们不希望一国存在两个政府。

我们当前的重要任务是恢复秩序、安抚难民并促进农商发展。我们将集中全部精力逐项完成任务，以便让后代能够和平地生活及贸易。我们发誓尽最大努力从目前的混乱中重建国家。

pages.en:
TRANSLATION

The birth of the Reformed Government of the
Republic of China

A saying taken from the ancients runs :
The best time of a year is in the spring. Spring is
the time for the development of all things. Every
thing living begins to awake and the people feel the
joy of life and enjoy their daily occupations. The
plans for the year are made in the spring time, because
spring is the first of the four seasons.

During the present wonderful season, a happy
event has now come to pass : the inauguration of a
new government for the Republic of China at Nanking.
Nanking was formerly the seat of the Chinese imperial
governments and has been occupied by the Kuomintang
and the Communist Party for more than ten years.
During the reign of those two parties, cruel
administrative reforms were introduced and the anger
of the people knew no bounds. Now that Nanking has
been cleared of those thieves, it is an auspicious
movement for the inauguration of the new government.

The fundamental policy of the new government
will consist of the following :-
(1) Enforcement of the constitutional government on
the basis of three yuans.
(2) Abolition of the ruling of the country by one
political party.
(3) Raising of a common front against Communism.
(4) Fostering of friendly relations with neighbouring
powers and adopting a foreign policy on the basis
of equality.
pages.zh:
译文

中华民国维新政府之诞生

古语有云：
一年之计在于春。春天是万物发展的时节。一切生物开始苏醒，人们感受到生活的喜悦并安于日常职业。一年的计划在春季制定，因为春为四季之首。

在这美好的季节里，一件喜事已然发生：中华民国新政府在南京成立。南京曾是中国历代帝制政府的所在地，并被国民党和共产党占领了十多年。在这两党统治期间，实施了残酷的行政改革，民怨沸腾。如今南京已清除这些窃国大盗，新政府的成立乃吉祥之举。

新政府的基本政策如下：
(1) 基于五院制实行宪政。
(2) 废除一党专政。
(3) 建立反共统一战线。
(4) 培养与邻邦的友好关系，并采取基于平等的外交政策。

pages.en:
- 2 -

(5) Rendering of assistance to the unemployed,
development of natural resources and acceptance
of foreign investments, with a view to economic
cooperation with foreign countries.

The successful administration of a country
depends upon the integrity of its administrative organs.
The people forming the personnel of the new government
are all prominent citizens and have adequate training
in various fields, included amongst those people are:-
Liang Hong Tse, Wen Chung Yao, Chang Zu Tsao,
Chen Cheh Ming, Wong Tse Wei; Ning yuan Dao,
Chen Ching Dao, Chen Loh and Chen Chun.

It is a matter for the highest congratulation
that the new government of the Republic of China has
obtained the services of these well known personages.

In the past several years, the Kuomintang and
the Communist Party, both composed of persons not
qualified for the position they held showed their
incompetence by their ungratefulness to neighbouring
powers for favours received and manifested the friendly
attitude to those powers which were really their
enemies. The waging of war by the two parties has
caused the people to suffer terribly. The inauguration
of the Reformed Government can, therefore, be considered
as the happiest event in the history of China.

"Long Live the Reformed Government
of the Republic of China."
pages.zh:
- 2 -

(5) 援助失业者，开发自然资源并接受外国投资，以期与外国进行经济合作。

国家的成功治理取决于其行政机构的廉洁。组成新政府的人员均为知名人士，并在各个领域受过充分训练，其中包括：梁鸿志、温宗尧、章祖昭、陈则明、王克敏；宁远道、陈静道、陈洛和陈春。（注：人名根据音译还原，部分可能对应历史人物如梁鸿志、温宗尧、陈则明、王克敏等，其余保留音译或推测）

中华民国新政府能获得这些知名人物的效力，是最值得祝贺之事。

在过去几年中，国民党和共产党均由不配其位者组成，他们因对邻邦所受恩惠不知感激而表现出无能，并对那些实为其敌人的列强表现出友好态度。两党发动的战争使人民遭受巨大苦难。因此，维新政府的成立可被视为中国历史上最幸福的事件。

“中华民国维新政府万岁。”

日军的真正敌人不是普通百姓，而是顽固且效率低下的中国士兵。那些对日军没有怨恨的人不应害怕逃跑，那些愿意协助日军的人将根据其所提供的服务获得报酬。即使是那些已从反日谬误中觉醒的中国士兵，也获得了过上新生活（意味着安全）的机会，他们过去的活动已被遗忘。每个人都应信赖日军，那么在日军的保护下就能实现和平与安乐。特别需要注意的是，反日者必将灭亡。

........

Advice to Our Comrades

Oppose Chiang Kai Shek's political rule and
support the newly established Central Government.
Why should we support the new government so
enthusiastically ? Because we have suffered too
much under the cruel pressure exerted by Chiang Kai
Shek. Even at present he is deceiving the people
and using their money. Soong and Kung, and others
under Chiang are using the money of the people for
their own selfish ends and deposit this wealth in
foreign banks. They have no interest in the welfare
of the people. To continue the present resistance
further will cause starvation to several hundred
thousands of refugees. You, comrades, who have
suffered under Chiang's cruel oppression, should
awake now. When the communists arrive, you will
suffer still more. We must overthrow, at once,
all those of the Chiang clique and we then can maintain
our livelihood. Under the new government we can live
and trade in peace. The people in North China are
enjoying life to the full and so will you under the
new government.

The Oriental Peace Society.

告同胞书

反对蒋介石的政治统治，支持新成立的中央政府。
我们为何如此热情地支持新政府？因为我们在蒋介石施加的残酷压力下受苦太多。即便在目前，他仍在欺骗人民并滥用他们的钱财。宋子文、孔祥熙及其他蒋系人员利用人民的钱财谋取私利，并将这些财富存入外国银行。他们对人民的福祉毫无兴趣。继续目前的抵抗将导致数十万难民饿死。遭受蒋氏残酷压迫的同胞们，现在应该觉醒了。当共产党到来时，你们将遭受更多苦难。我们必须立即推翻所有蒋系分子，然后我们才能维持生计。在新政府下，我们可以和平地生活和贸易。华北人民正在充分享受生活，在新政府下你们也将如此。

General Chou Feng-chi (周鳳岐) and the fact that Mr. Tang
Shao-yi (唐紹儀) has definitely refused to take any part
in the administration, some slight changes have been made
in the personnel of the new administration.
    According to information from well informed
sources, the new government had originally proposed to secure
some well known and old members of the Kuomintang, such as
pages.zh:
《大美晚报》3月15日讯：    1938年3月16日 上午

“中华民国政府”将于3月16日成立

据本报从可靠消息来源获悉，备受关注的“中华民国政府”将于3月16日在南京正式成立。然而，由于周凤岐将军之死以及唐绍仪先生明确拒绝参与该政权，新政府的人员组成发生了一些细微变化。
据消息灵通人士透露，新政府原计划争取一些知名的国民党元老，例如

pages.en:
arch 16, 1938. Morning Translation.

Mr. Tang Shao-yi, to act as leader in order to win public confidence. However, Mr. Tang firmly refused to join the new administration. It is, therefore, assumed that the highest post in the new government, namely that of Chief Executive, will be left vacant for the time being.
It was widely rumoured that General Wu Kwang-sin (  ), brother-in-law of the late Marshal Tuan Chi-ju (  ), will be nominated Minister of War. However, this is not true for according to reliable information not only has General Wu definitely refused to accept the post, but, with a view to avoiding unnecessary trouble, he has left Shanghai. It is now learned that one General Li Pao-chang (  ), a former commander of the enforcement of martial law in Shanghai and Woosung during the regime of General Sun Chuan-fang (  ) will be appointed Minister of War.
Rumours are also rife that following the formal inauguration of the new government, the Dah Deo City Government in Pootung will undergo a complete reorganization, and that one Sheng (  ), the descendant of a well-known high official of the defunct Manchu Government, will be nominated Mayor of Shanghai. However, according to information from another reliable source, the Mayor of Shanghai will be one Chen Chun (  ).
All the officials of the new government proceeded to Nanking by the Nanking-Shanghai Railway on March 15. Commencing from to-day, March 16, strict precautionary measures will be adopted along the Nanking-Shanghai railway, while Japanese aeroplanes will reconnoitre over Nanking for the double purpose of ensuring the safety of the new officials during the formal assumption of their posts and preventing an air attack.
In connection with the inauguration of this new government, local newspapers, both foreign and Chinese, received a copy of a lengthy manifesto from a certain news agency on the night of March 14. This manifesto is issued in the name of a body known as the "Federation of Representatives from the Various Provinces of the Chinese Republic". It strongly criticizes the National Government at Chungking and states that with a view to preserving the existence of the Chinese race as well as maintaining friendly relations with the various foreign nations, Messrs. Liang Hung-tse (  ), Wen Chung-yao (  ) and Tseng Sz-chao (  ) have been appointed the responsible delegates of the "Federation" to undertake the formation of a "Government of the Chinese Republic". In conclusion, the manifesto emphasizes: "We are determined through thick and thin to restore our national rights and we leave it to the world to judge the legality or otherwise of our action." The manifesto is signed by 536 so-called principal representatives.
It is said that a large number of copies of this manifesto have been printed and will be distributed in various parts of Shanghai and along the Nanking-Shanghai Railway.

1938年3月16日。晨间译文。

唐绍仪先生出任领袖，以赢得公众信任。然而，唐先生坚决拒绝加入新政府。因此，据推测，新政府的最高职位，即行政院长一职，将暂时空缺。
此前广泛传言，已故段祺瑞元帅的姻兄弟吴光新将军（  ）将被提名为陆军部长。然而，这并非事实，因为根据可靠消息，吴将军不仅明确拒绝接受该职位，而且为了避免不必要的麻烦，已离开上海。现获悉，前孙传芳（  ）将军统治时期上海与吴淞戒严司令李宝璋将军（  ）将被任命为陆军部长。
另有谣言四起，称在新政府正式成立后，浦东的大道市政府将进行彻底改组，一位盛（  ）姓人士（已故满清政府著名高官的后裔）将被提名为上海市市长。然而，据另一可靠来源的消息，上海市市长将由陈春（  ）担任。
新政府的所有官员已于3月15日乘京沪铁路前往南京。从今天3月16日开始，京沪铁路沿线将采取严格的预防措施，同时日本飞机将在南京上空进行侦察，双重目的是确保新官员在正式就职期间的安全，并防止空袭。
关于新政府的成立，3月14日晚，当地中外报纸均收到某新闻社发来的一份长篇宣言副本。该宣言是以一个名为“中华民国各省代表联合会”的机构名义发布的。宣言强烈批评重庆的国民政府，并称为了保存中华民族的存在以及维持与各国的友好关系，梁鸿志（  ）、温宗尧（  ）和曾世兆（  ）三位先生已被任命为“联合会”的责任代表，负责组建“中华民国政府”。宣言最后强调：“我们决心不顾一切恢复我们的国权，至于我们行动的合法性与否，留待世界评判。”该宣言由536名所谓的主要代表签署。
据悉，该宣言已大量印刷，并将分发至上海各地及京沪铁路沿线。

March 8, 1933.
Morning Translation

To Mei an Foo Morning Edition :-

ASSASSINATION OF GENERAL CHOU FENG-CHI

At 1.45 p.m. yesterday General Chou Feng-chi (周鳳岐), former Commander of the 26th Army, returned to his home at No. 80 Avenue du Roi Albert, French Concession, in his motor car (licence number 5082) from the Dah Tung Shing Stone Company (大東興石礦公司) on Peking Road where he maintains an office. After taking his meal, he left home and as he was boarding his motor car, six men appeared from their places of concealment in the vicinity and two of them fired 13 shots at him with Mauser pistols. Taken by surprise, the General was fatally wounded with one bullet in the head and two in the chest. The assailants immediately decamped and made good their escape before the arrival of the Police.

The General was removed to Ste. Marie Hospital but he succumbed en route. The General's chauffeur, who is a Formosan, escaped unhurt. He has been questioned by the Police for a description of the assailants.

It is learned that the late General was Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Dah Tung Shing Stone Company at the time of his death. The motor car which he was using belongs to an intimate friend named Huang (黃).

Another report says that before the murder four suspicious looking men called at the General's home requesting an interview with the General but left when they were informed that the General was not at home.

The late General Chou Feng-chi who is also known as Chou Kung-sien (周恭先), 58 years of age, native of Changhing (長興), Chekiang, was a graduate of the Chekiang Military Academy. He had held many military appointments including Chief of Staff to the Commander of the Chekiang Army and Military Advisor to the Kwangtung Provincial Government. In 1924 he was Commander of the Third Division under General Sung Chuen-fang who was at that time Tupan of Chekiang. In 1925 he was appointed Defence Commissioner of Nanking when this city was occupied by General Sung's forces. In 1926 he surrendered to the Nationalist Army and was appointed Commander of the 26th Army. In 1927 he was Deputy Martial Law Enforcement Commander for Woosung and Shanghai and concurrently Head of the Military Affairs Department of the Chekiang Provincial Government.

He was wanted on Circular Order of Arrest No. 1725 issued by the Shanghai Second Special District Court on June 16, 1932, for an offence endangering the security of the State, but this order was cancelled in Autumn last year when he came to Shanghai from Nanking. It is reported that the men formerly under his command assisted in the landing of Japanese forces at Kingsanwei (金山衛) in September last year. After the fall of Hangchow the General left Shanghai for Hangchow via Huchow (湖州) and about one month ago he came to Shanghai from Hangchow. Most of the troops now in Chekiang are men formerly under his command. Of late it was widely reported that he would take part in the "Central China Provisional Government," and his murder may have been due to this.

晨间译稿

致《美安福报》晨刊：-

周凤岐将军遇刺案

昨日下午1时45分，前第二十六军军长周凤岐（Chou Feng-chi）将军乘坐汽车（牌照号码5082），从位于北京路的大东兴石矿公司（其办公室所在地）返回法租界亚尔培路80号的寓所。用餐后，他离开寓所，正当他登上汽车时，六名男子从附近隐蔽处现身，其中两人使用毛瑟手枪向他开了13枪。将军猝不及防，头部中一弹，胸部中两弹，受致命伤。刺客在警察到达之前立即逃窜并成功逃脱。

将军被送往圣玛丽医院，但在途中身亡。将军的司机是一名台湾人，未受伤。警方已对其问话，以获取对刺客体貌特征的描述。

获悉，死者生前是大东兴石矿公司的董事会主席。他所使用的汽车属于一位名叫黄（Huang）的密友。

另有报告称，在谋杀发生前，四名形迹可疑的男子曾到将军寓所拜访，要求面见将军，但在被告知将军不在家后离去。

已故周凤岐将军，又名周恭先（Chou Kung-sien），58岁，浙江长兴人，毕业于浙江武备学堂。他曾担任多项军职，包括浙江陆军司令参谋长及广东省政府军事顾问。1924年，他在时任浙江督军的孙传芳（Sung Chuen-fang）将军麾下任第三师师长。1925年，当孙将军部队占领南京时，他被任命为南京卫戍司令。1926年，他归顺国民革命军，并被任命为第二十六军军长。1927年，他任淞沪戒严司令部副司令，兼浙江省政府军事厅厅长。

他曾被上海第二特区地方法院于1932年6月16日发布的第1725号通缉令通缉，罪名为危害国家安全，但去年秋天他从南京来到上海后，该通缉令被撤销。据报道，他昔日的部下协助了去年9月日军在金山卫（Kingsanwei）的登陆。杭州沦陷后，将军经湖州（Huchow）从上海前往杭州，约一个月前又从杭州来到上海。目前浙江的大部分军队都是他昔日的部下。最近有广泛传闻称他将参加“华中临时政府”，他的被杀可能与此有关。

March 8, 1938.

Shanghai Mainichi

ASSASSINATION OF GENERAL CHOU FENG-CHI

Anti-Japanese terrorists in the
French Concession ceased their activities for a time owing
to the strict measures adopted by the Japanese authorities.
General Chiang, however, recently issued instructions to
his followers and terrorists to assassinate any Japanese
so as to disturb the peace and order behind the Japanese
front and also to use every possible means to prevent
Chinese approaching Japanese. One result of these
instructions is the assassination of General Chou Feng-
chi which took place in the French Concession in broad
daylight on March 7. The French policemen who were on
duty in the vicinity of the incident did nothing to prevent
the lawless act or to arrest the offenders. This strange
attitude of the French Police is attracting the attention
of the public.

At about 1.40 p.m. March 7,
General Chou came out of his residence at No.80 Avenue
du Roi Albert and was entering his motor car in front of
his residence when he was surrounded by three terrorists
who fired more than ten shots at him. The General received
several bullet wounds in the head and face and collapsed,
while the assassins made good their escape.

It is strange that the French
police who were on duty in the vicinity of the scene did
not hear any shots and took no steps to arrest the offenders.
Later the General was removed to
French Police Headquarters in a police car and was not given
first aid treatment. Thus he succumbed on the floor at
police headquarters.

The French authorities became
much perturbed and arrested all the members of the General's
family on suspicion of being connected with the assassination.
General Chou, aged 58, was
formerly Commander-in-Chief of the 26th Army of the National
Revolutionary Army. Later he was elected a member of the
Committee of the Chekiang Provincial Government and of the
Military Affairs Commission of the National Government. Of
late he has been endeavouring to restore peace and order in
Central China in co-operation with the Japanese authorities
and his activities attracted the attention of the National
Government.

The strange attitude of the French
authorities towards the incident is arousing much attention
from the public. Certain quarters have started an
independent investigation. It is said that some members
of the staff of the French Police are connected with the
assassins.

《上海每日新闻》

周凤岐将军遇刺案

法租界内的抗日恐怖分子因日本当局采取的严厉措施而暂时停止活动。然而，蒋介石将军最近向其追随者和恐怖分子发出指令，要求刺杀任何日本人，以扰乱日军后方的和平与秩序，并尽一切可能阻止中国人接近日本人。这些指令的一个结果便是3月7日白天在法租界发生的周凤岐将军遇刺案。事发地点附近的执勤法国警察未采取任何措施阻止这一非法行为或逮捕罪犯。法国警察这种奇怪的态度引起了公众的关注。

3月7日下午1时40分左右，周将军从亚尔培路80号的寓所出来，正在寓所前进入汽车时，被三名恐怖分子包围，他们向他开了十多枪。将军头部和面部多处中弹倒地，刺客则成功逃脱。

奇怪的是，事发地点附近的执勤法国警察竟未听到任何枪声，也未采取任何步骤逮捕罪犯。
后来，将军被警车送往法国警察总局，但未得到急救治疗。因此，他在警察总局的地板上身亡。

法国当局大为惊慌，以涉嫌与刺杀案有关为由，逮捕了将军的所有家庭成员。
周将军，58岁，曾任国民革命军第二十六军总指挥。后来当选为浙江省政府委员及国民政府军事委员会委员。最近，他一直努力与日本当局合作，恢复华中地区的和平与秩序，其活动引起了国民政府的注意。

法国当局对此事件的奇怪态度引起了公众的极大关注。某些方面已开始进行独立调查。据说，法国警察的一些职员与刺客有牵连。

SECRET
According to information received, the new "puppet"
government known as the "Central China Government" will be
officially inaugurated next Sunday, March 13th, in Nanking.
A great number of Chinese politicians who are now
staying at the New Asia Hotel will fly to Nanking to participate
in the ceremony in a few days time. A Chinese military band
recently organized in Shanghai by the "Ta Tao Municipal
Government" has already gone to Nanking to help in the ceremony.
The new regime is said to have been organized on
the principles of the Kuomintang Government, which consists
of five yuans and also will use the same Kuomintang flag.
With this tactics they hope to win the trust of the people more
effectively and show to the world that they are only against
General Chiang Kai Shek.
The principal figures in the new government will be
Mr. Liang Hung-chi (梁鴻志), president of the Executive Yuan,
Mr. Chang Shi Chiao (章士釗), president of the Judicial Yuan,
Mr. Wen Tsung Yao (溫宗), president of the Legislative Yuan,
Mr. Chen Chun (陳羣), Minister of Education, Mr. Chen Lu (陳籙),
Minister of Foreign Affairs and Mr. Chen Chun Foo (陳春圃),
Minister of Finance.
Mr. L.K. Kentwell is also reported to be leaving for
Nanking shortly, presumably in connection with the inauguration
of the new government.
The Japanese Authorities are reported to be not
satisfied with the above mentioned group of Chinese politicians
but are unable to get better men to join the new government
at present.

由帕普（Papp）督察撰写并转呈。
机密
据收到的情报，被称为“华中政府”的新“傀儡”政府将于下周日，即3月13日，在南京正式成立。
目前居住在新亚酒店的大量中国政客将在几天内飞往南京参加典礼。由“大道市政府”最近在上海组建的一支中国军乐队已前往南京协助典礼。
据说新政权是按照国民党政府的原则组织的，设有五院，并将使用相同的国民党党旗。通过这种策略，他们希望更有效地赢得民众的信任，并向世界表明他们仅反对蒋介石将军。
新政府的主要人物包括：行政院院长梁鸿志先生、司法院院长章士钊先生、立法院院长温宗尧先生、教育部长陈群先生、外交部长陈籙先生以及财政部长陈春圃先生。

February 21, 1938. Morning Translation

Ta Mei Wan Pao Morning Edition :-

PLANS TO FORM REGIME IN KIANGSU PROVINCE

With a view to establishing a "new political regime" for Shanghai as well as for Kiangsu and Chekiang Provinces, a certain number of disappointed politicians in Shanghai sometime ago contemplated the formation of a so-called "Peace National Salvation Association." However, as the Japanese authorities, especially General Matsui, were in favour of forming a "new central political regime" at Nanking before a similar one for Kiangsu and Chekiang comes into existence, the proposed formation of the "Peace National Salvation Association" was shelved.

It is learned that the "new central political regime" at Nanking may not be formed after all because the Japanese military authorities in Central China and North China as well as the Japanese Cabinet and the War Ministry hold different views regarding the formation of a "puppet regime."

Taking advantage of this, the disappointed Chinese politicians who had proposed the creation of a "Peace National Salvation Association" have become very active again and are supporting Mr. Chen Tao-yi (陳陶遺), ex-Governor of Kiangsu Province, to become the Chairman of the bogus regime in Kiangsu Province.

Mr. Chen Tao-yi, who was Chief Secretary to the Shanghai City Government Provisional Assembly before the fall of Shanghai, left here recently for Kweichow via hongkong at the request of Mr. Wu Ting-chang (吳鼎昌), Chairman of the Kweichow Provincial Government.

One Zau Hou-sun (趙厚生), who is Chief Secretary to the Foh Shing Hsueh Huei Association (復興學會), the formation of which was promoted by General Huang Fu, General Chang Chun and others and of which Mr. Chang Chia-ngau (張嘉璈) is Chairman, arrived in Shanghai from Szechuan recently. Whilst in Hongkong, Zau had an interview with Chen Tao-yi and it is reported that Zau has persuaded Chen to take up the post. On arriving at Shanghai, Zau has been in close touch with the Japanese authorities and elements of the "Peace National Salvation Association."

The promoters of the Association have been holding meetings once a week to discuss plans to accelerate the establishment of a bogus regime in Kiangsu Province.

《大美晚报》晨刊：-

在江苏省组建政权的计划

为了为上海以及江苏和浙江省建立一个“新政治体制”，上海的一些失意政客不久前曾考虑组建一个所谓的“和平救国会”。然而，由于日本当局，特别是松井将军，主张在南京先建立一个“新的中央政治体制”，然后再建立类似的江浙政权，拟议中的“和平救国会”的组建被搁置。

据悉，南京的“新的中央政治体制”可能最终无法成立，因为日军华中和华北当局以及日本内阁和陆军省在组建“傀儡政权”问题上持有不同观点。

利用这一情况，那些曾提议创建“和平救国会”的失意中国政客再次变得非常活跃，并支持前江苏省省长陈陶遗先生出任江苏省伪政权的主席。

陈陶遗先生在上海沦陷前曾任上海市政府临时议会秘书长，最近应贵州省政府主席吴鼎昌先生的请求，经香港前往贵州。

赵厚生，复兴学会秘书长，该学会由黄郛将军、张群等人推动成立，张嘉璈先生任会长，最近从四川抵达上海。赵在香港期间会见了陈陶遗，据报道赵已说服陈接受该职位。赵抵达上海后，一直与日本当局及“和平救国会”分子保持密切联系。

该会的推动者每周举行一次会议，讨论加速在江苏省建立伪政权的计划。

Chinese Politicos
In Shanghai Plan
Central Regime

Tang Shao-Yi Pressed
To Assume Position
Of Premier

QUARREL FOR CHIEF
POSITION ALLEGED

Chinese With 'Grudge'
Against Hankow
Give Aid

Echoing the recent official statements in Tokyo favoring the establishment of a "Central China Government," a movement is in full swing in Shanghai among a group of disgruntled Chinese politicians for the inauguration of a new regime with jurisdiction over the Japanese occupied areas in Kiangsu, Chekiang, and Anhwei provinces under the presidency of Mr. Tang Shao-yi, first premier of the Chinese republic and member of the Central Supervisory Committee of the Kuomintang, according to reliable sources today.

Despite Mr. Tang's recent statement that his only desire is to return to his native place in Chungshan, Kwangtung, the veteran statesman is reported to have been repeatedly approached by sponsors of the movement to emerge from his retirement and assume the post as chief executive of the new "government." Mr. Tang is staying in the French Concession.

Chief Sponsor

Marquis W. H. Li, otherwise known as Mr. Li Kuo-chich, is prominently mentioned as the chief sponsor of the movement for the establishment of the new "government" in Central China. It is alleged that the marquis, a grandson of Lord Li Hung-chang, is living in a foreign hotel in Hongkew under Japanese protection. He is stated to be anti-Central Government because of the legal complications that followed his loan transactions with a realty firm while serving as the general manager of the China Merchants' Steam Navigation Company.

Declaring the transaction as illegal, Marquis Li was sentenced by the Chinese courts to three years' imprisonment and ordered to refund the realty firm Tls. 700,000 which he is alleged to have received as a "commission." Mr. Li, however, declared that the money had been handed over to Mr. Chen Fu-mo, then supervisor of the shipping firm appointed by the Ministry of Communications. He was only recently allowed release on bail from a detention cell of the Nantao District Court.

Plans Meet Set-back

Mr. Li's activeness in the plans for the inauguration of the new government, it is further alleged, has caused a set-back because of a "civil war" over the posts in the new regime. Mr. Li is reported to have appointed himself the prime minister and solicited the services of other disgruntled politicians to fill the cabinet posts. The latter are said to have resented his arrangements on the ground that Mr. Li has never had a political career in the Chinese government and is not considered as competent for the high post.

Another chief sponsor of the movement is declared to be Mr. Wang Tze-wei, described as a Formosan in the employ of the Japanese special service. Mr. Wang is also reported to have been promised a high post in the proposed "government."

Former Minister Active

Rumors also are current that Mr. Li Shih-hou, finance minister in the defunct Peking Government and a close associate of Mr. Wang Keh-min, the chairman of the Executive Council of the "Provisional Government in Peking," is also actively engaged in the movement for the "Central China Government." He is reported to have visited Peiping recently to discuss with Mr. Wang on future relationship between the two "governments" and the possibility of their "amalgamation."

The name of a prominent Chinese businessman is also linked with the movement. He is stated to be in favor of the movement because of his "grudge" against the Kuomintang which ordered his arrest when the Nationalist troops entered Shanghai in 1927. The prominent businessman is stated to be scheduled as the next mayor of Shanghai replacing the "Ta Tao City Government" formed by "small fry" politicians.

据今日可靠消息来源称，为响应东京方面近期支持建立“华中政府”的官方声明，上海的一群失意中国政客正全力推进一项运动，旨在建立一个管辖江苏、浙江、安徽等日占区的新政权。该政权拟由中华民国首任总理、国民党中央监察委员唐绍仪先生担任主席。

尽管唐先生近期声明其唯一愿望是回到广东中山故里，但据报，该运动的发起人已多次接触这位资深政治家，敦促其结束隐退生活，出任新“政府”的最高行政首脑。唐先生目前居住在法租界。

主要发起人

李国杰侯爵（又名李国禔）被公认为是建立华中新“政府”运动的主要发起人。据称，这位李鸿章勋爵的孙子目前在日本人的保护下，居住在虹口的一家外资酒店内。据称他反对中央政府，是因为他在担任轮船招商局总经理期间，与一家地产公司的贷款交易引发了法律纠纷。

中国法院宣布该交易非法，李侯爵被判处三年监禁，并被勒令退还据称其收受的70万两“佣金”给该地产公司。然而，李先生声称这笔钱已移交给当时的交通部委派的航运公司监督人陈孚木。他直到最近才获准从南市地方法院看守所保释。

计划受挫

据进一步称，李先生在筹建新政府计划中的活跃表现已导致进程受挫，原因是内部正为新政权的职位爆发“内战”。据报李先生已自命为国务总理，并招揽其他失意政客充任内阁职位。据说后者对他的人事安排感到愤慨，理由是李先生在中国政府中从未有过政治生涯，被认为不称职担任此高职。

该运动的另一位主要发起人据称是王子惠（音译），被描述为受雇于日本特务机关的台湾人。据报王子惠也被许诺在拟议的“政府”中担任高职。

前部长表现活跃

目前还流传着李思浩也积极参与“华中政府”运动的传闻。李思浩曾任已不存在的北京政府财政部长，是“北平临时政府”行政委员会委员长王克敏的亲信。据报他近期访问了北平，与王氏讨论两个“政府”未来的关系以及“合并”的可能性。

一位著名的中国商人的名字也与该运动联系在一起。据称他支持该运动是因为他对国民党心怀“怨恨”，1927年北伐军进入上海时，国民党曾下令逮捕他。据称这位著名商人预定将出任下一任上海市长，取代由“小人物”政客组成的“大道市政府”。

TRANSLATION OF FRENCH POLICE REPORT NO. 2212/S DATED 28.1.38.

SUBJECT: Constitution of a New Central China Government
- Mr. TANG SHAO YI.

For some time past rumour has consistently had it
that a government distinct from that established by the
Japanese in Peking, would be created in the near future
in Nanking. The Japanese, in spreading the news of
the creation of this new Government, do not fear to
advance the merits and qualifications of Mr. TANG SHAO YI,
the Kuomintang veteran. Up to the present Mr. TANG has
refrained from making any statement. His attitude,
however, permits one to believe that even if he has not
openly accepted the Japanese solicitations, negotiations
which are being made by certain interested persons, are
doubtless under weigh.

Born in 1860 at Tang-Yu in the province of
Kwangtung, Mr. TANG SHAO YI is now 67 years of age. At
the age of thirteen years, he was sent to the United
States by the Manchu Government with the first group of
students to proceed to foreign lands. He remained in
America for seven years, studying at the University of
Columbia and at the University of New York. He
returned to China without a degree. Nevertheless, during
the Manchu regime he held important posts: secretary to
the Imperial Resident in Korea (YUAN SHIH KAI) in 1883;
in 1900 he assisted YUAN SHIH KAI in suppressing the

事由：关于组建新华中政府——唐绍仪先生。

一段时间以来，一直有传言称，近期将在南京建立一个不同于日本人在北平所建政府的新政府。日本人在散布创建新政府的消息时，不惜推崇国民党元老唐绍仪先生的功绩和资历。到目前为止，唐先生一直未发表任何声明。然而，他的态度让人相信，即使他没有公开接受日方的拉拢，由某些利益相关者进行的谈判无疑正在进行中。

唐绍仪先生1860年出生于广东省唐家（音译），现年67岁（原文如此）。十三岁时，他被满清政府作为第一批留学生派往美国。他在美国待了七年，就读于哥伦比亚大学和纽约大学。他未获得学位便返回中国。尽管如此，在满清时期他仍担任要职：1883年任驻朝鲜办事大臣（袁世凯）的秘书；1900年协助袁世凯镇压山东义和团起义；1904年被派往西藏任特使；1905年任外务部右侍郎；1907年任邮传部左侍郎；1907-1908年任奉天巡抚；1911年作为袁世凯的代表在上海与革命党人谈判和平条款。在……之后

尽管他担任上述最后职务，但他参与了由不满的南方政客发起的反对蒋介石将军独裁的所有活动。1932年8月，他抗议《塘沽协定》，并指责蒋介石放弃了东北四省。他抗议宋子文先生从美国借入的五千万美元小麦贷款。毫无疑问，为了结束这位元老的抨击，1934年中山县居民向中央政府控告广东政府贪污。同年10月6日，中山警备司令被免职，随后发生暴动，迫使唐绍仪先生放弃该模范区。10月10日，他经广州抵达香港。15日，他向西南政务委员会递交了中山模范区县长的辞呈，此后便隐居于这块英国殖民地。
